description: Οδικά Διευρωπαϊκά Δίκτυα Μεταφορών στην Ελλάδα is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΕΓΝΑΤΙΑ ΟΔΟΣ ΑΕ – Παρατηρητήριο Εγνατίας Οδού. Aktuální, pokud jde o pokrok a dokončení projektů, transevropská silniční síť (hlavní a komplexní). Coverage: Greece. The publisher named on the listing is ΕΓΝΑΤΙΑ ΟΔΟΣ ΑΕ – Παρατηρητήριο Εγνατίας Οδού. Its keywords include Δίκτυο, Οδικό, repository.data.gov.gr, Διευρωπαϊκά δίκτυα μεταφορών, Ten-t, Κεντρικό οδικό δίκτυο. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
